notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too!
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, Mini Words 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

Today is the Day! The Olympicats DLC is now live!

The wait is over, and we’re thrilled to announce that the Olympicats DLC for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together is officially available! Dive into a world of sports, unity, and adorable cats with our latest release.

🌟 Experience the Thrill: Join cats and characters from around the globe as they compete in friendly and exciting sporting events.
🌟 Celebrate Unity and Peace: Enjoy scenes that highlight the values of sportsmanship, respect, and international camaraderie.
🌟 Creative Possibilities: Use the new Olympicats assets in the Community and Creative Maker to design and share your unique scenes. Mix and match items from all your scenes to create something truly special.

The game is fully prepared for the new DLC. Get ready to explore, create, and celebrate with the Olympicats DLC. Thank you for your support, and enjoy the fun!

Start your Olympic journey now:

notes.title: Update - bug fixes, small improvements
notes.notes:
Hi, thanks for playing Floating Farmer.

This update includes:

Tilt Five mode (AR):
- Improved initial wand tracking and menu navigation.
- Reset zoom when finishing a level. Without this, the Next Level button was inaccessible when the camera was zoomed in.
- Update to Tilt Five 1.00 SDK 
- Fixed delay in detecting the start button pressing when using the Tilt Five wand.

Classic mode:
- Fixed bug preventing finished farms from appearing on land.


Floating Farmer supports Tilt Five!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010274/29a929283c6131f831d9f0ff2969f1fb39794e3d.png
Tilt Five™ is a holographic gaming system that transforms tabletop and video games into 3D vibrant holographic environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010274/e2c0afd73ef2a6fba11d03b89837d4196215d6a7.jpg

- Wearing the Tilt Five™ augmented reality (AR) glasses, you'll feel like you're among the clouds, flying over a beautiful field of farms. The farm to be arranged will be at your fingertips, allowing you to explore every detail of the plants and animals, zooming and rotating the farm using the wand.

- Use the tip of the wand to select and push the blocks in the desired direction to solve the puzzles.

- See up close the joy of puppies finding their mothers and returning home!

Visit Tilt Five's website to find out more.
